mock.welcome:
Welcome to your new home in Ghent, Lotte 🏠

We noticed you moved. Here are 3 things to sort out:

1. Confirm your address. It's still the Kortrijk one, so letters and cards can still go there. I can set it to Ghent, Sint-Amandsberg, once you confirm the street.
2. Tenant fire insurance. You don't have any, and tenants in Flanders have needed it since 2019. A quote takes about 2 minutes.
3. Shared costs. They're going through manual transfers. A shared budget can keep them in one place.
mock.how: How do you know I moved?
mock.evidence:
From your account, in plain language:

• 18 Aug — €1,150 to a rental guarantee account, "huurwaarborg"
• 25 Aug — €650 to your Kortrijk landlord, "laatste huur"
• 3 Sep — €575 rent to Immo Vandenberghe, "huur sept"
• 5 Sep — €420 to Verhuisbedrijf De Snelle Verhuis
• 12 Sep — a new Engie direct debit, €68
• 16 Sep — €18 to Stad Gent, "adreswijziging"
• Groceries moved from Colruyt Kortrijk to Colruyt Gent and Delhaize Sint-Amandsberg
• Your NMBS subscription was not renewed

If this isn't right, tell me and I'll drop it.
mock.confirm:
That's right. We moved on 6 September. Let's do the address and the insurance. I'm in Sint-Amandsberg.

My partner and I keep sending money back and forth for shared costs. Is there an easier way?
mock.plan:
Address: I'll pre-fill Ghent, Sint-Amandsberg. I don't have the street, so nothing is saved until you confirm it.

Fire insurance: your Kortrijk studio was on your landlord's policy, and there isn't one for the new place yet. I'll price a tenant policy as soon as the street is in. No paperwork, and you can stop whenever you want.

Shared costs: a monthly transfer labelled "gedeelde kosten" has been coming in. A shared budget lets you and your partner cover rent and bills without sending money back and forth. I won't open one unless you ask.

One more thing, since it's payday: you're no longer paying about €95 a month for the train. Your savings are lower after the move. Want to put that €95 toward rebuilding your buffer, on top of the €150 you already save?
mock.savingsYes: Yes, put the €95 into savings. I'll send the street later today.
mock.done:
Done. From November, €95 a month goes to your savings, on top of the €150 you already transfer. You can change or stop it in the app.

I'll wait for the street before I update your address or show the insurance quote. Nothing else needs doing until you're settled.
